svg.title: Kasir POS: data model
svg.desc: Tenant and outlet: One store with its business type, time zone, enabled modules and tax settings; every other row carries its tenant id. User, staff and role: Owner and staff accounts with scrypt-hashed passwords and PINs, roles and a per-store permission matrix. Product and category: Menu items with price, modifier groups, station (kitchen or bar), stock tracking and optional bundle components. Transaction: A sale with its order lines, payments, discounts, refunds, idempotency key, cashier and shift snapshot. Shift and cash movement: A cashier's drawer session with opening and closing counts by denomination, cash in and out, handovers and shortages. Kitchen ticket: Items of an order routed to a station, each with its own status, linked to the sale or open order. Table and self-order: Tables with a rotating QR token, and guest orders placed from them that wait to be paid at the cashier. Ingredient, recipe and movement: Raw materials with unit, minimum and last price; recipes link products to ingredients for cost of goods; movements are append-only. Operational expense and supplier: Itemised shop purchases with payment sources, receipt photos and price comparison; suppliers are created from purchases. Customer and debt: Customer profiles, loyalty points and store credit with due dates and payments. Event: The append-only audit trail: type, actor, payload and time for every sensitive change. MCP client, token and agent action: Registered agent clients, hashed access tokens bound to a store, draft actions with their decision, and the agent action log.
